description.value: The study examined whether functional connectivity during cigarette cue exposure was associated with the ability of nicotine-deprived smokers to resist smoking during the first day of a quit attempt.

spans.text: The goal of the current study was to address these issues by examining the association between functional connectivity during cigarette cue exposure and smoking behavior during the first 24 h of a quit attempt.
